description: This PHP class 'LinkRenderer' extends a base LinkRenderer to handle the rendering of links within Markdown content, specifically for Confluence integration. It processes URLs to determine if they are internal, external, or anchors, and constructs Confluence-specific XML elements for link representation.

classes.name: LinkRenderer
classes.description: A specialized renderer for links within Markdown content that outputs Confluence-formatted XML, handling internal and external URLs appropriately.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a link node into a Confluence-specific XML element, processing the URL for internal/external distinctions and incorporating link properties.
